name_en: Kakke — triangles of buckwheat dough dipped in garlic miso
summary_ja: そば粉を薄くのばして三角形に切り、大根や豆腐とだしで煮てにんにく味噌をつけて食べる。南部藩がそば切りを禁じたため、切れ端を三角に整えて食べたのが始まりと伝わる南部地方の料理。
summary_en: Thin buckwheat dough is cut into triangles, simmered with daikon and tofu, and dipped in garlic miso — said to have begun when the Nanbu domain banned fine-cut soba, leaving people to eat the offcuts instead.
